complete_examples.text: In this paper, based on the finite element software ABAQUS, a simulation analysis model for the track-tunnel-surrounding rock system was estab lished to simulate the process of fault movement.
Firstly, the model of track-tunnel-surrounding rock system established by ABAQUS is used to simulate the effect of fault dislocation, and the deformation and stress of the rail can be obtained.
